title: Should Contain - Substring Validation
description: Learn to validate that strings contain specific substrings—essential for error messages and flexible validation.

theory.title: Exercise 1.3.2: Should Contain - Flexible String Validation
theory.content:
MENTOR-9 displays a holographic error message with specific words highlighted.

"PROTO-7, exact matches aren't always practical. Error messages have timestamps, IDs, variable data. The Should Contain keyword lets you verify the important parts while ignoring the rest."

What is Should Contain?

Should Contain validates that a string contains a specific substring. It's a partial match assertion.

Why Partial Matching Matters

  • Error messages: "Error at 14:23:47 - Hull breach detected" contains "breach"
  • Dynamic content: "User #1234 logged in successfully" contains "logged in"
  • Flexible validation: Don't care about exact format, just key information
  • Real-world data: Timestamps, IDs, and variable parts change constantly

Basic Syntax

Should Contain    ${string}    ${substring}

Arguments:

  • First argument: The full string to search in
  • Second argument: The substring to find

Simple Example

*** Test Cases ***
Error Message Check
    ${error}           Set Variable    Hull breach detected in sector 7
    Should Contain     ${error}    breach
    Log                Error contains 'breach' - validation passed!

What Happens:

  1. Create variable with full error message
  2. Check if "breach" exists anywhere in the message
  3. ✅ Found → assertion passes
  4. Log success

Case Sensitivity

Important: Should Contain is case-sensitive by default!

*** Test Cases ***
Case Sensitive Search
    ${message}         Set Variable    Hull Breach detected
    Should Contain     ${message}    Breach     # ✅ PASSES - exact case match
    Should Contain     ${message}    breach     # ❌ FAILS - case mismatch

For case-insensitive matching, convert to same case first:

*** Test Cases ***
Case Insensitive Check
    ${message}         Set Variable    Hull Breach Detected
    ${lower_msg}       Convert To Lowercase    ${message}
    Should Contain     ${lower_msg}    breach    # ✅ PASSES

Multiple Substring Checks

You can verify multiple substrings in the same message:

*** Test Cases ***
Multi-Check Validation
    ${report}          Set Variable    Diagnostic: 3 warnings, 1 critical error
    Should Contain     ${report}    warnings
    Should Contain     ${report}    critical
    Should Contain     ${report}    error
    Log                All key terms found!

Real-World Use Cases

1. Error Log Validation

*** Test Cases ***
Check Error Logs
    ${log_entry}       Set Variable    [2157-03-15 14:23:47] ERROR: Connection timeout - retry failed
    Should Contain     ${log_entry}    ERROR
    Should Contain     ${log_entry}    timeout
    Should Contain     ${log_entry}    retry failed

2. API Response Validation

*** Test Cases ***
API Response Check
    ${response}        Set Variable    {"status": "success", "user_id": 1234, "message": "Login successful"}
    Should Contain     ${response}    success
    Should Contain     ${response}    user_id

3. Page Content Validation

*** Test Cases ***
Web Page Validation
    ${page_content}    Set Variable    Welcome to Starlight Explorer Dashboard
    Should Contain     ${page_content}    Welcome
    Should Contain     ${page_content}    Dashboard

Should Contain vs Should Be Equal

AspectShould Be EqualShould Contain
Match Type Exact match Partial match (substring)
When to Use Values must be identical Only care about key parts
Flexibility Strict Flexible
Example "Error" == "Error" "Error at 14:23" contains "Error"

Custom Error Messages

*** Test Cases ***
Custom Message
    ${status}    Set Variable    System operational - no errors
    Should Contain    ${status}    error    msg=Status message should contain 'error' keyword

Failure Output:

AssertionError: Status message should contain 'error' keyword

Related Keywords

Should Not Contain

Verifies a string does NOT contain a substring:

*** Test Cases ***
Negative Check
    ${status}              Set Variable    System operational
    Should Not Contain     ${status}    error    # ✅ PASSES - no 'error' found

Should Contain X Times

Verifies exact number of occurrences:

*** Test Cases ***
Count Occurrences
    ${log}                      Set Variable    ERROR: failed, ERROR: timeout, ERROR: disconnect
    Should Contain X Times      ${log}    ERROR    3

Best Practices

1. Choose Meaningful Substrings

*** Test Cases ***
Good Substring Choice
    ${error}    Set Variable    Critical hull breach in sector 7 - immediate action required

    # ✅ Good: Specific key term
    Should Contain    ${error}    breach

    # ❌ Bad: Too generic
    Should Contain    ${error}    in

2. Be Careful with Case

*** Test Cases ***
Case Awareness
    ${msg}    Set Variable    ERROR: System Failure

    # Know your data's case!
    Should Contain    ${msg}    ERROR     # ✅ PASSES
    Should Contain    ${msg}    error     # ❌ FAILS

3. Combine with Other Assertions

*** Test Cases ***
Combined Validation
    ${response}    Set Variable    {"status": "error", "code": 500}

    Should Contain     ${response}    error          # Has error
    Should Contain     ${response}    500            # Has status code
    Length Should Be   ${response}    35             # Correct length
